subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should an omitted public `facing` parameter on iOS remain the documented fixed `front` default, or intentionally resolve to a user-selected Talk preference?
rationale: The branch changes the externally observable default for direct node invocation, while the normal agent path currently bypasses that fallback; maintainers need to select one coherent cross-surface contract before a mechanical repair can be finalized.

options.title: Honor the Talk preference on omitted iOS captures
options.body: Preserve omission through the nodes media tool, document the iOS-specific user preference default, and prove explicit facing still overrides it on device.

options.title: Keep front as the universal omission default
options.body: Retain the current nodes-tool serialization and limit the flip control to a separately designed capture API rather than altering `node.invoke` semantics.

recommendation.title: Honor the Talk preference on omitted iOS captures
recommendation.body: Preserve omission through the nodes media tool, document the iOS-specific user preference default, and prove explicit facing still overrides it on device.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR context identifies steipete as the recent author of the affected iOS Talk implementation; current-main history was unavailable for a stronger owner attribution.
